ambiguities_or_notes: The audited Russian Markdown has a source-layer defect after «карандашом»: a bare numeral ‘3’ appears in the body and footnote [^3] is absent. The official 90-volume electronic edition at vol. 75, pp. 209–210 confirms that this is a footnote marker and supplies the omitted note. The English restores marker [^3] and translates that verified note without modifying the Russian repository.
The editorial heading retains the uncertain date ‘January 28?’; editorial note 1 separately records an unknown-hand pencil notation ‘Feb. 1905.’ Neither date is normalized or reconciled.

«Лучшее, по моему мнению, я отчеркнул карандашом» is kept concretely as ‘What I think is best I marked off in pencil,’ preserving Tolstoy's physical marking rather than abstracting it to selection or approval.

«Проставляю еще в оглавлении баллы» is rendered ‘I am also putting scores in the table of contents,’ retaining the literal idea of numerical/graded marks rather than replacing it with a freer editorial paraphrase.
The recovered footnote's title «Круг чтения» follows the repository's established English title *Circle of Reading*.
